V_1 rulings on the v001 return (PRELIMINARY, relayed ~17:48 ET) applied: (1) CAPTAIN-OFFICE H1 over-cluttered judged by the read - clearly piled and messy = OK, large desk with neat stacks = SCRIPT-DRIFT 'tidy, not cluttered'; L01, L02, L04, L10 re-viewed and all read tidy -> DRIFT; L03 stays DRIFT; (2) daytime lighting OK with note; (3) plain papers/folders OK; (4) MEETING seat counts OK with capacity notes; (5) CAPTAIN L05 gold dome OK, ADVISORY, recognisable local landmark. Earlier V_1 set rulings still applied (out-of-frame = OK+note; dark = lighting choice; 1x lettering = QUALITY-FAIL, zoom-only = ADVISORY; person in set = QUALITY-FAIL). Card shas verified vs CARDS_INDEX_v002.tsv. Images: 20 (10 per group, all 1280x720); sha256 = screener's own from image files, all match maker BATCH indexes; no duplicate shas. column7: note

1280x720. Long table, high-backed captain's chair at head under blank whiteboard = front position (H1 met); chairs both sides of table incl. his right, plus row of 6 extra chairs along right wall for other officers. Single door rear right. No window (windowless interior; H2 Day permitted, not shown - note). Framed landscape prints, desk phone: no text/logos. No people. No defects.

1280x720. Briefing-room layout: podium + desk at front (captain front, H1 met), ~24 chairs in two blocks facing it; right-hand block serves agents on his right + officers. Door with vision panel at left. Windowless (H2 Day permitted, not shown). Blank whiteboard. Small podium mic only. No people/text.

1280x720. Oval table, captain's chair at far end under blank whiteboard (H1 met), seating both sides. Two doors (rear-left, right) give good arrival/exit access. Blinds on left windows show grey daylight city (H2 Day met, overcast). Second whiteboard partly in frame at right, blank. No people/text.

1280x720. Long table with power grommet, captain's chair at head (H1 met), chairs both sides plus stacked folding chairs at right wall for extra officers. Two blank whiteboards. Glass-panel door rear right with daylit corridor/window beyond (H2 Day permitted). Framed dark city print at left: no text, no recognisable landmark at 3x. No people.

1280x720. Captain's desk + chair front centre under blank whiteboard (H1 met), ~24 padded chairs in two blocks; right block serves agents/officers. Daylit windows at left (H2 Day met). Door rear right. Ceiling security camera, desk lamp, coffee maker - ordinary dressing, no text. No people.

1280x720. Smaller square-ish table, 6 chairs incl. head chair at window = front (H1 met). Daylit skyline window (H2 Day met); skyline generic, no identifiable Boston landmark. Door with wired-glass panel + closer at right (closer housing blank at 3x). Note: smallest capacity in the group (6 seats) - other officers would stand; reads corporate more than precinct (agency/era open per R5, not a miss). No people/text. Seat count/capacity OK with this note per V_1 ruling (4).

1280x720. Older wood-panelled room: captain's desk + leather chair front centre (H1 met), wooden desks/chairs in rows facing it. Daylit sash window at left (H2 Day met). Double doors right. Dark chalkboard (blank) in place of whiteboard - whiteboard is a Grok proposal only. Green exit-sign pictogram above door, no letters at 3x - ordinary signage, OK. Brass desk plaques blank at 3x. Blank papers on desks, no text. No people.

1280x720. Small conference room: rectangular table, 7 chairs, head chair at far end under blank whiteboard (H1 met). Blinds on large window, grey daylight (H2 Day met, overcast). Steel door with vision panel + closer at right; wall thermostat/panel blank. Note: small capacity - other officers would stand. No people/text. Seat count/capacity OK with this note per V_1 ruling (4).

1280x720. U/horseshoe table, captain's chair front centre (H1 met), chairs along both arms plus row of 6 chairs on back wall for other officers. Daylit blinded window at left (H2 Day met). Door with vision panel right. Blank easel whiteboard. Plain water bottles - no labels/text at 3x. No people.

1280x720. Modern glass-topped long table, tufted head chair under blank whiteboard (H1 met). Chairs only on the camera-right side of the table; the other side is bare - staging/coverage note (agents-on-his-right side depends on blocking; chairs can be added), not a contradiction. Daylit window with trees (H2 Day met). Double glass-panel doors left. Wall TV off. Head-chair reflection in glass is furniture, not a person. Reads corporate (R5 open, not a miss). No people/text. Seat count/capacity OK with this note per V_1 ruling (4).

1280x720. Re-judged per V_1 ruling (1): tidy, not cluttered. Large double-pedestal desk carries 5 squared, neat paper stacks plus lamp, phone, two mugs, small tray - reads organised, not piled and messy; H1 only partly met (large yes, over-cluttered no). Two upholstered visitor chairs (H2 met). Wood door with frosted glass swung open (H3 met). Daytime lighting OK per V_1 ruling (2); H4 night use by relight. Plain papers/folders OK per ruling (3) (H5 folders are agent-held, SS:L1764). Framed certificates: pseudo-text only at 3x zoom - ADVISORY. No people/logos.

1280x720. Re-judged per V_1 ruling (1): tidy, not cluttered. Night (H4 met). Large metal desk with 7 squared, evenly spaced stacks and one lamp; heavy volume but orderly, nothing loose or messy - H1 only partly met. Nearest of the four to the OK side because of the volume. Two visitor chairs + desk chair (H2 met). Door with vision panel (H3 permitted). Squad room beyond blinds checked at 1.5x, no people. Underlit (lighting choice, traits confirmable). Plain papers OK per ruling (3). No text/logos.

1280x720. Day; exposed brick, arched window, radiator. Desk is cluttered (stacked trays, papers spread, beige CRT, mug) but is a modest single-pedestal writing desk that does not read as large - H1 only partly met. One wooden chair + worn couch (H2 met). Distressed door ajar in right foreground (H3 met). Daytime lighting OK per V_1 ruling (2); H4 night use permitted by relighting - note. Shelf frames blank; binders unlabeled. Room reads small for Steele + two agents + John blocking (TCM-14/33) - coverage note. No people/text.

1280x720. Re-judged per V_1 ruling (1): tidy, not cluttered. Large L-shaped desk with neat stacks and a few sheets laid flat in rows, two monitors, phone, tower - orderly working-office read, not piled and messy; H1 only partly met. Three visitor chairs (H2 met). Flush door with vision panel + closer (H3 met). Daytime lighting OK per V_1 ruling (2). Plain papers/folders OK per ruling (3). Cork-board sheets: pseudo-lines only at 3x - ADVISORY. No people/logos.

1280x720. Dusk/blue hour, lamps on (H4 met). Large mahogany desk heaped with paper stacks, CRT, keypad phone, coffee cups, pen cup (H1 met). Round side table with 3-4 leather chairs + chairs at frame edges (H2 met). Heavy panelled door wide open (H3 met). Papers read white rather than manila - H5 folders are agent-held props (SS:L1764), OK. ADVISORY (recognisable local landmark; V_1 ruling 5 keeps OK): a gold-domed building on the skyline reads as a recognisable Boston landmark (State House-like) - Boston-compatible per card but location-specific; not text/logo. No people.

1280x720. Night (H4 met), single gooseneck lamp, 1970s styling. Large steel double-pedestal desk with stacks, typewriter, beige terminal; papers spilled across floor (H1 met). Two orange vinyl chairs (H2 met). Frosted-glass door closed (H3 permitted). Underlit - lighting choice, traits confirmable. Folders/papers include tan/manila tones (H5 met). Era read 70s is a Grok/Nova open item (R5), not a miss; flashback-bookend reuse fine. No people/text.

1280x720. Night (H4 met). Large white desk with many manila folder stacks + sticky notes, laptop, monitor, mugs, lamp (H1, H5 met). Mesh chairs + sofa (H2 met). Frameless glass door standing open (H3 met; note: a glass door is a weaker fit for the kick-open beat SS:L1332, staging only). Monitor/laptop screens show code-like lines only at zoom, no letters at 1x - ADVISORY. Open-plan floor beyond glass checked at 1.5x: chairs/monitors only, no people. Reads corporate rather than precinct (R5 open, not a miss). No logos.

1280x720. Rainy grey day; green cinderblock, tube light. Steel desk covered with tied manila bundles, CRT, fan (H1 met - cluttered; desk mid-size; H5 met). Two plastic stacking chairs (H2 met). Dented steel door with wire-glass panel, ajar (H3 met). Daytime lighting OK per V_1 ruling (2); H4 permitted by relight - note. File boxes everywhere. Note: grime/derelict read more storage room than working captain's office - variety, not marked down. No people/text.

1280x720. Night (H4 met), brass lamp, CRT glow, closed blinds. Large wooden desk with paper stacks, open binder, takeout box, mugs, phone, crumpled paper (H1 met). Two leather visitor chairs (H2 met). Six-panel door closed (H3 permitted). Coat rack. Papers read white more than manila - H5 plain papers OK per V_1 ruling (3). Underlit, traits confirmable. No people/text.

1280x720. Re-judged per V_1 ruling (1): tidy, not cluttered - tidiest desk in the group. Large oak desk with 6 neat stacks, monitor, pen cup; H1 only partly met. POV through open doorway, door in right foreground (H3 met). Two wooden visitor chairs + leather desk chair (H2 met). Open filing drawers. Daytime lighting OK per V_1 ruling (2). Plain papers OK per ruling (3). No people/text.
